issues.legal_issue: A custodian administering evacuee property cannot require an alleged unauthorized occupant to account for or pay rents and profits through a summary order when the governing law provides no such power.
material_facts: The property owners had migrated to Pakistan, and the properties in India were treated as evacuee property vested in the Custodian.
The appellants possessed the properties under exchanges that were not confirmed; the Custodian set aside the earlier confirmations and treated their possession as unauthorized.
The Custodian ordered the appellants to surrender possession and to account for rents and profits they had received.
The appellants challenged the Custodian’s authority to order the accounting; the issue pressed before the Court was limited to that authority.
issues.conclusion: The Custodian had no power under the Act to order the appellants to account for rents and profits without using the ordinary legal remedy of a suit. The Court quashed the part of the order requiring payment of rents and profits, while leaving both sides free to pursue any claims available to them by law.
issues.legal_principle: Section 10 of the Administration of Evacuee Property Act, 1950, including its general management power and enumerated powers, did not authorize the Custodian to determine and summarily recover rents and profits from an unauthorized occupant. Rule 10(1) authorized recovery of possession, and Rule 10(2) concerned certain tenants or licensees, but neither authorized the summary determination or recovery of rents and profits at issue. Such a claim had to be pursued through the ordinary remedy of a suit. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: evacuee_property_custodian_proceeding and occupant_alleged_unauthorized and order_requires_rent_accounting and summary_accounting_power_not_granted

predicates.evacuee_property_custodian_proceeding: The proceeding concerns a custodian administering property treated as evacuee property.
predicates.occupant_alleged_unauthorized: The custodian treats a person in possession of the property as lacking lawful authority to possess it.
predicates.order_requires_rent_accounting: The custodian orders the occupant to account for rents or profits received from the property.
predicates.summary_accounting_power_not_granted: The governing law does not grant the custodian power to determine and summarily recover rents and profits from the occupant.
predicates.custodian_cannot_order_summary_rent_acco: The custodian cannot require the occupant to account for rents and profits by summary order.

issues.definition: When a custodian administering evacuee property orders an alleged unauthorized occupant to account for rents or profits, and the governing law grants no summary accounting power, the custodian cannot impose that requirement by summary order.
